_comment: BISECTION ARM E — float + eq34 ONLY.  480 epochs, 60 sta.
Built by ADDING one knob group to the float 480 arm rather than by
subtracting from the trio, so the delta against the reference is explicit.
THE LADDER this completes (each step adds exactly one thing; the whole
point is to localize WHERE the settled runaway is born):
F    float                              _simnet60_tri_slant_480_ddint
E    + eq34                             THIS ARM
ECI  + carry_invariant                  _simnet60_ab_eci_eq34_ci
ECIS + seed_round        (= trio−ewl)   _simnet60_tri_slant_trio_480_noewl
TRIO + ewl_enable                       _simnet60_tri_slant_trio_480
MEASURED SO FAR: TRIO settled per-band med|e| 2280 cyc; ECIS 3700 cyc.
So the last rung (ewl) is not the driver — falsified 2026-08-13.  This arm
and ECI ask whether eq34 alone, or carry_invariant on top of it, is where
the runaway appears.
NOTE ON A CONFOUND that shifts partway down this ladder: carry_invariant
empties R.pl_amb (ApplicationNetworkAssembly.cpp:2546-2560), which is the
residual pool BOTH RAIM tiers pool over, so RAIM is LIVE on F and E and
structurally INERT on ECI/ECIS/TRIO (verified: T3 shows 0 opportunities on
the latter).  Adjacent-rung comparisons are clean except across the E→ECI
step, which changes both carry_invariant AND RAIM liveness.  Do not read
that one step as single-variable.
Loader: seed_round requires eq34 (GnssConfigLoadNetwork.cpp:4416) and
carry_invariant requires eq34 (:5761) — hence eq34 is rung 1 and there is
no legal carry_invariant-without-eq34 arm.
